mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below the 12-month moving average signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO drops by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above the 6-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 decreases and UNRATE rises during a recession.
